title: Extension-Fee Source-Fare Rates — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers Schedule
content:
Schedule of the extension-fee source-fare rate for credits of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers, by the fare brand under Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand that the ticket the credit arose from was sold as.

| Fare brand of the ticket the credit arose from | Extension-fee source-fare rate |
|---|---|
| Crestline Main Flexible | 0.70 |
| Crestline First | 0.70 |
| Crestline Main Plus | 0.85 |
| Crestline Premium Economy | 0.85 |
| Crestline Main Cabin | 1 |
| Crestline Basic Economy | 1 |

**Schedule rule.** The extension-fee source-fare rate is 0.70 when the ticket the credit arose from was sold as Crestline Main Flexible or Crestline First, 0.85 when it was sold as Crestline Main Plus or Crestline Premium Economy, and 1 for any other fare brand.

**Note.** The ticket read is the credit's source ticket, as recorded under Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.

**Hypothetical reading.** A credit that arose from a Crestline Premium Economy ticket carries 0.85. A credit that arose from a Crestline Main Cabin ticket carries 1.
